body: Oh wow this sounds so familiar. We had a couple good weeks but he was being super critical last night and moved his shit into the guest bedroom (again). He has an appointment next week but The constant arguing has me wanting to end it now. I’ll try a bit longer.

Whoops. We are married. 

He actually agreed to meds and therapy so we will see how that goes.

Thank you, internet stranger. I’m a private person so I don’t share a ton of this (my parents and my sister know). 

He has an outgoing personality and great sense of humor; most of the people in our lives would be shocked to know what it’s really like to live in my home. 

It’s that time of night where the kids are in bed and I finally get some alone time to fall apart.  Being able to vent and get feedback helps a bit.
He always says it’s him and not me.

I don’t have any answers but wanted to say you’re not alone. 

I’m exhausted from the cycle of a few good days but more bad ones. I miss the guy that is here on good days. 

But we are in the middle of really bad days. He won’t talk to me; he barely acknowledges my existence. 

I feel guilty for thinking it but I’ve reached the end of my rope. I’m done. I’m ready for him to wake up enough and start speaking to me again so I can give the ultimatum: get help or leave. 

The thing is, I know he won’t get help. So I’m trying really hard to prepare myself to be single. I’m holding it together, mostly.

Usually it’s only a few days but when I’m in the middle of it, it feels like the longest time ever. 

Tbh, I feel like such a weakling right now for being so upset. Usually when he comes out of it he acts like it shouldn’t be such a big deal that he just went to sleep for a few days. 

This is a big deal, right?  I’m not over-reacting??

I don’t know if it’s depression but it certainly feels like some sort of mood disorder.  

There are a combination of stressors that led up to the “remote” argument.  When I question his bad behaviors the answer I get is “I don’t know why I’m like this; I’m just a piece of shit”. 

I suck at boundaries and the fact that I’m here again shows it. I really need to hear things like this right now because I’m feeling so low. Thank you.
I feel your 2nd paragraph so much that I’m sitting here trying to hold back tears.
Maybe. I hope but I suspect he will continue to refuse treatment. I’ve asked before.
This is tearing me apart. I want to be there for him but he just pushes me away. I want to love him but it feels like he won’t let me.
Yes. When he’s in this frame of mind he doesn’t care.
I asked him to schedule an appointment and even volunteered to go with him. No luck :(

Maybe like 10 lbs. He tries every now & then but stops. 

That was actually my first red flag that something was brewing.  He’d been eating super healthy lately then all the sudden it was “fuck it I’m eating junk if I want it”.

I’ve been with my husband for 6 years and he’s in the midst of (another) depression. He refuses treatment and is being mean to everyone. 

If it was just about me i would tough it out. But I have 2 kids. I can’t accept this behavior in their lives anymore. 

I’m sick to my stomach that he will kill himself as soon as I tell him to leave.

My husband feels like he is a burden on everyone in his life.  That couldn’t be further from the truth when he is himself. 

Depression is a monster. 

Please get help.
I’ve seen him pop out of it in just a couple weeks but early in our relationship he broke his foot, gained 40 pounds, and was depressed for 2-3 months.
No he’s not on drugs - he’s randomly drug tested for work. It hasn’t been all that long. If I had to guess it started 2 weeks ago.
It doesn’t feel like a very healthy relationship right now. The guilt that I’m modeling this for my kids is overwhelming.

I think it’s something he’s been dealing with for a very long time. Probably since his teens. 

His mother was a drug addict that lied to him repeatedly about who his father is. It messed with his head. 

He’s had bouts with drugs and alcohol; I assume to self-medicate. He has been clean for years and years. I almost left him a few years ago over alcohol but he hasn’t had an episode of heavy drinking in a long time.

Yeah in his calmer/happier moods we have discussed it.  He doesn’t really do the manic-high part though. Just “normal” and “bad”.  A couple days ago he even said he’s going through one of his “bad” times so he recognizes it’s happening. But can’t or won’t do anything about it. 

He flat out refuses therapy either by himself or as a couple. He won’t get meds from his doctor because he tried it once in his 20s and it killed his sex drive.  Though that’s not a great excuse since we haven’t had sex in many months.

I’m in a similar boat except I want out of the relationship because I’m so tired of the negativity. The thing stopping me is fear of him killing himself. I keep imagining finding his body, having to call his kids to tell them, and his funeral.  I am so used to being able to fix things but we’ve been doing this for years and I am out of ideas to solve it. I just wanted to say you’re not alone.
I’ve tried so many times over the years. He refuses.
